description: Ministry of Power, Energy & Business Development - National Energy Policy and Strategies of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of a new national energy policy and strategies, which constitutes a regulatory framework. It establishes legal and policy guidelines for the energy sector, including implementation mechanisms, monitoring committees, and supersedes previous policies. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of publishing regulatory content rather than focusing on personnel changes or portfolio assignments, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
